eligibility: A and B train separately per mode; C and D train on all five modes with labels.

protocol.metric_protocol: Paper metrics use native observed metre coordinates and generated coordinates interpolated to the corresponding native count; 16 x 16 training bounds, 20 training length-quantile bins, natural-log JS, top 20 occupied-cell F1.
protocol.motion_protocol: Both paths on the same 200-point elapsed-time grid. Equal weight per trip for pooled 199-interval speed W1. Slow means below 1 m/s. An entry requires a preceding fast interval and two consecutive slow intervals.

all-C-42.matching_rule: Disjoint minimum-cost pairs. All five standardized continuous attributes within 0.75 SD, departure within 180 minutes, each OD cell coordinate within 2 grid steps.
